Description: Retries publishing failed/new outbox events to Kafka. Picks up records with status NEW or ERR with < 3 attempts, ordered oldest first, batch of 100. Sends payload to Kafka topic from record's type field. On success marks SENT with sentAt. On failure increments attempts and marks ERR. Mutex flag prevents overlapping executions. Max 3 retries per event — exceeded events effectively dead-lettered.
Criticality Reason: Transactional outbox relay. Ensures at-least-once delivery of ALL domain events across ECGF and E-Procurement. Failure means domain events (plan approvals, loan submissions, claim decisions, tender publications) never reach downstream consumers. Dead-lettered events (3+ failures) need manual intervention.
Domain Event: Publishes ALL domain events (16+ topic types)
Important Log Fields: batch_size, events_sent, events_failed, dead_lettered_count, job_duration_ms, trace_id
Sensitive Data: Event payloads may contain loan amounts, PFI details, claim information, procurement data.
Dependencies: DB: Outbox (findAll status IN NEW/ERR AND attempts < 3, update status/sentAt/attempts). Kafka: KafkaProducerService.send() to dynamic topics.
Existing Observability: Logger (NestJS built-in, context=OutboxPublisher). Logs search start, errors, result count.
Observability Gap: Has basic logging but no custom metrics. No dead-letter alerting. No queue depth tracking. No publish latency histograms. No event-type breakdown.
Notes: Cron every 5 min. Mutex for overlap prevention. Max 3 retries then dead-letter. Topics: ProcurementPlanItemSubmitted/Approved, RequisitionLineSubmitted/Approved, TenderLotSubmitted/Approved, TenderPublished, LoanApplicationSubmitted/Approved/Resubmitted, PfiOnboardingApplication, ClaimApproved/Rejected, IndividualReportApproved/Rejected, TenderLotClarificationSubmitted.

Description: Purges successfully-sent outbox records older than 30 days. Prevents outbox table from growing indefinitely. Only deletes status=SENT with sentAt older than 30-day retention window. Mutex flag prevents overlapping executions.
Criticality Reason: Data hygiene. Prevents table bloat. Failure means growing table but no business impact.
Dependencies: DB: Outbox.destroy() WHERE status=SENT AND sentAt < cutoffDate (bulk delete).
Existing Observability: Logger (NestJS built-in, context=OutboxHousekeeping). Logs start and count deleted.
Observability Gap: Has basic logging but no purge count metrics.

Description: Handles internal outbox.enqueue events from domain services. Saves event to outbox table within transaction. Immediately attempts Kafka publish via afterCommit callback. On success marks SENT. On failure marks ERR (OutboxPublisher cron retries later). Uses GZIP compression for Kafka messages.
Criticality Reason: Write-side of transactional outbox pattern. Every domain event in the system flows through this handler. Transaction wrapping ensures event record exists before publish attempt. afterCommit pattern ensures DB consistency.
Important Log Fields: event_id, topic, entity_type, entity_id, correlation_id, publish_success, trace_id
Sensitive Data: Event payloads contain domain-specific data (loan amounts, claims, procurement data).
Dependencies: DB: Outbox.create() in transaction (INSERT), Outbox.update() post-commit (status). Kafka: KafkaProducerService.send() with GZIP compression.
Existing Observability: Logger (NestJS built-in, context=OutboxService). Logs save, send attempt, success/failure.
Observability Gap: Has basic logging but no custom metrics. No per-topic publish tracking. No publish latency measurement. No correlation between domain event and its outbox delivery.
Notes: @OnEvent('outbox.enqueue', { async: true }). Uses afterCommit callback. GZIP compression. EnqueueOutboxEventInput interface (no runtime validation).
